# @sharadox/form-web-library

> Server-side forms: bot checks, rate limit, contact action emailing via @sharadox/email-web-library.

- /contact-action: createContactAction({ to, company (sender "<company> Web Application", subject "<company> Web Application · <labels.contact> · Name (Company)"), senderAddress?, site (domain; the form's `page` field is shown only on it or a subdomain), logo?: () => Promise<{ content, contentType, filename }> (inline cid:logo at the top), design? { background, foreground, accent }, languageNames?, acknowledgement?: { [locale]: { subject, eyebrow, heading(name), paragraphs, messageLabel } } (automatic reply to the visitor's email, in their language, reply-to = to; a failed reply never fails the send), choices?: { key: label }, reach? = 'email' | 'email-or-phone', requireMessage? = true, minimumMessageLength? = 1, requireChoice? = false, fields?: { name: label }, labels?: Partial<ContactLabels> (English default, ENGLISH_LABELS), rateLimit? = 5/hour per address, dailyMaximum? = 50 emails/day from everyone (per server instance; caps email cost under a flood), readConfiguration?, createSender?, reportError? }) → (form, ip) => { status: idle|sent|invalid|rate-limited|failed }. Reply-to = visitor when they gave an email; bots get fake 'sent'. The email: branded layout (logo + company on the design, accent line), every detail, the message, then Form (page), Language (name), Sent (UTC), IP.
- Form fields: name, email, phone (valid: + digits spaces ().- with ≥7 digits), company, message, extra fields, locale, started-at, page (location.href at sending), website (honeypot), need (checkboxes).
- /parse-contact: parseContact(form, { choices, choiceField='need', reach, requireMessage, minimumMessageLength, requireChoice, fields, now }) → value { name, email, phone, company, message, locale, choices, fields }
- /contact-check isEmail(text), isPhone(text) (browser-safe, same rules as the server); /bot-check isLikelyBot; /rate-limit createRateLimiter({ window, maximum }); /field readField(form, name, max)
- Env: EMAIL_SERVER_HOST/PORT/USERNAME/PASSWORD, EMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- 0.5.0: createContactAction takes `design` (email-web-library ^0.4.0 EmailDesign; plainDesign(company) by default) instead of `theme`, and lays out both emails with emailLayout; the notice has a button to answer the visitor (labels.reply "Reply to" + first name, or labels.call "Call" when only a phone was left); an acknowledgement may carry a `button`; with a design signature, the reply leaves out its line to the site; contact-email (brandedEmailHtml) is removed: use email-web-library's emailLayout
- 0.5.1: README's example passes a real EmailDesign
